Maria (CS): Heads-up: BrioHealth renewal in ~5 weeks. Usage declined ~52% last month. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dash/brio
Ajay (AE): They ran a short eval with AltModel and asked about cost/latency. Champion (Priya) still engaged but quieter.
Maria (CS): Any recent stakeholder changes?
Ajay (AE): Procurement switched contact to T. Nguyen. Engineering lead is on a different project, so slower momentum.
Sylvie (AM): Proposal: 20-30m sync, short benchmark vs AltModel, offer 10-day Dedicated trial, success criteria doc.
Zoe (Enablement): I can prepare a 1-pager and a 3-slide benchmark summary by tomorrow morning.
PlatformBot: Snapshot: api_keys active 18->9, avg tokens/day 800k->370k, 95p latency +15ms, flagged: usage_drop.
Maria (CS): Ajay please send quick pre-call note and calendar invite. I'll own follow-ups and open a renewal play ticket.
Ajay (AE): Sending invite for Thu 2pm PT. Included link to dashboard and placeholder deck.
Sylvie (AM): I'll draft the eval acceptance checklist (SLOs + monitoring window).
Zoe (Enablement): Uploaded sample addendum to drive and the benchmark deck.
PlatformBot: Ticket CS-7925 created, tag: renewal_monitor.
Maria (CS): Thanks team. We should highlight routing/fallback and KV caching versus AltModel in the call.
Ajay (AE): Will bring that up. Report back after the sync. :calendar:
